title: Clerks II
about: Dante and Randal trade the Quick Stop for a fast food counter on Dante's last day before he moves to Florida.

Mooby'sClerks IISame counter, different job.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMooby's onion ringsButtermilk-soaked onion rings in a smoky paprika crumb, fried crispHow to make it3 large onions300ml buttermilk200g plain flour1 1/2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp salt2 L vegetable oil, for frying125ml tomato sauceSlice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.Dredge in flour mixed with paprika and salt.Heat the oil to 180°C and fry in batches until crunchy.Serve with tomato sauce stirred with a pinch more smoked paprika.Donkey show jalapeño poppersJalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in baconHow to make it12 jalapenos150g cream cheese80g cheddar, grated6 rashers of baconHalve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.Mix the cream cheese with the cheddar and fill each half.Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon.Bake at 200°C until the bacon is crisp.Rooftop chicken salad croissantsChicken salad croissants for the rooftop danceHow to make itAs written, serves 4Buttery croissants filled with poached chicken, celery, grapes and toasted almonds in a lemon and tarragon mayo, with crisp cos leaves.Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred.Mix with 2 finely diced celery sticks, 100g halved red grapes, 40g toasted flaked almonds, 120g mayo, the juice of half a lemon and 1 tbsp chopped tarragon.Season well.Split 4 large croissants, line with cos leaves and pile in the chicken salad.Wrap in baking paper and pack in a basket.MainsMooby's double cheeseburgerTwo smashed beef patties with American cheese and special sauceHow to make it600g beef mince1 tsp salt8 slices of American cheese4 sesame burger buns4 dill pickles1 onion, diced4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp tomato sauceRoll the mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce.Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook, then flip and add cheese.Stack 2 per toasted bun with pickles, diced onion and sauce.Mooby's hot honey crispy chicken burgerCrispy hot honey chicken. May I take your order?How to make itAs written, serves 4Buttermilk-soaked chicken thighs fried until crackling, brushed with hot honey, in soft buns with shredded lettuce, pickles and a garlic mayo.Soak 4 chicken thigh fillets in 250ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for at least 2 hours.Mix 150g plain flour, 1 tsp paprika, half a tsp cayenne and salt.Dredge and fry in oil at 170°C for 7 to 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and a dash of vinegar and brush over the chicken.Toast 4 burger buns, spread with garlic mayo and fill with lettuce, chicken and pickles.SweetsEmma's farewell sheet cakeVanilla buttercream sheet cake. Eat it, don't wear it.How to make it200g butter, softened, for the cake200g caster sugar4 eggs300g self-raising flour125ml milk150g butter, softened, for the buttercream300g icing sugarBeat the butter for the cake with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.Bake in a lined tin at 175°C.Cool completely.Beat the butter for the buttercream with the icing sugar, spread over and pipe a goodbye message across the top.DrinksUdderly Delicious chocolate shakeChocolate ice cream, milk and chocolate syrup blended thickHow to make it1 L chocolate ice cream500ml milk4 tbsp chocolate syrupBlend the ice cream, milk and chocolate syrup until thick and smooth.Pour into 4 tall paper cups and serve with straws.
